batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b JD Ryder

batting.dismissal: c SC Ganguly b A Nehra

batting.name: PP Chawla

balls.text: Short of a length again, Rahul sharma tries to swipe across the line and misses. A good final over by Faulkner as he keeps a check on the flurry of sixes
banged in short, Rahul looks to pull it and misses
Bowled this time, shuffles across and looks to whip it over to the fine leg region but misses and his furniture is disturbed
straighter, slaps it past the ground but can manage only a single
on the legs, turns it to square leg
Smith has gone crazy here, full toss outside leg and smears it over deep square leg, as flat as it can get
Pandey plonks his front foot forward, swivels and heaves it high over deep midwicket for a mammoth shot!
on the legs, thumps on to his pads and rolls on to the off side for a leg bye
this time he goes high over deep midwicket, Smith is turning it on here
stands tall and thrahes it straight over the bowler's head and over the sight screen, terrific shot!
beamer again, Harmeet singh is off, what a stunning catch from Nayar here in the deep midwicket, comes running and takes a blinder but in vain
waist high beamer, shuffles across and smashes it to deep square leg region for a four
Bowled! leg cutter, Uthappa swipes across the line and tries to hit it out of the stadium but misses and his stumps are disturbed
slower one, gets behind the line and smacks it over mid-on, one bounce to David Hussey at long-on
on the legs, slaps it down the ground and bisects the fielders at deep midwicket and long-on for a four
shuffles across and tries to pull it over midwicket but only manages to hit to midwicket
on the full, looks to drill that past cover but mistimes it for a single
on the full, digs it out to extra cover for a single
misses a full toss as he tries a reverse scoop, that should have been dismissed
in the slot, makes room and smashes it through covers and Bipul sharma at the sweeper cover does well
quicker one outside off, looks to carve it over point but misses, straight to keeper
makes room, looks to pull that over mid wicket, misses it and Gilchrist removes the bails off but Uthappa is well cemented
on the middle, flicked to deep midwicket, well timed
Caught and bowled! slower delivery on the full, Ferguson looks to strike it on the on side, takes a leading edge and goes straight to the bowler
slower delivery that kept low, that came off the back of his hand and hit him on the pads,  sliding down the leg side
outside off, driven to covers off the backfoot for no run
good length, Uthappa shuffles across and plays a wristy shot to wide of deep midwicket for two, well run
on the off, punched to cover and the batsmen pinch a single
on the middle and leg, knocked to wide of long-on for a tight two
on the full, blocked back to the bowler
on the off, turns it to deep midwicket for a single, try to sneak a two but 'no' says Ferguson
slower delivery, plays it gently to mid wicket and hurry for two
Bowled! Samuels looks to heave it over deep midwicket, swipes across the line but misses and the ball crashes into his middle and off
on the full, punches it straight to long on for a single
one handed six, that's a monstrous hit from Uthappa, picks the length well and deposits over the long-off fence
takes a swipe across the stumps and misses, Gilchrist removes the bails in a flash and we go upstairs to check if he's stumped, 'Not out' says the third umpire
on the full, crunches it past the bowler straight down the ground for a single
slower one, smears it to the sweeper cover and Valthaty misfields it and gives away a four
outside off, watches it till the end and steers it fine to third man for a four, 100 up for Pune
on the full, punches it straight to Uthappa at the non striker's end and deflects
on the middle and off, smashes it down the ground to long-off but only a single is what they get
on the legs, chips it into the air to deep midwicket for a single
on the full, Uthappa punches it straight to long-off
slower delivery, dabs it to point, Mandeep hits the stumps but Uthappa is well home
on the pads again, ball rolls on to the on side
on the pads, hits the pads and off it goes to the right of short fine leg
back of a length, tries to pierce  the gap between point and short third man but the ball goes to point
full on the pads, glances it to short fine leg, a direct hit but Samuels is well home as confirmed by the third umpire
back of a length, knocks it to short cover and an overthrow lets the batsmen go through for a single
straighter one, powerfully struck down the ground, fielder at long-on cuts it off
outside off, bunts it to the off side for no run
angling in, defends it back to the bowler
on the full, shows the full face of the bat to the bowler
opens the face and deliberately runs it down to the third man fence for a four
angling into the batsmen, comes forward and knocks it down to long-on
slightly short outside off, dabs it to short third man and scamper for a single
outside off, drives it off the bottom of his bat to sweeper cover for an easy single
makes room and cuts it low to short third man for an easy single
outside off and steers it to short third man for no run
comes forward and gets hit on the pads for no run
quicker one, blocks it to the off side
Samuels has teed off here, dances down the track and goes downtown over long-on fence into the crowd
gets forward and drives to long-off again
he makes room and gets well forward and bashes it down the ground to long-off, Faulkner had little chance cutting it off
comes over the wicket this time, down the leg side and swept to short fine leg
Uthappa gets well forward down the pitch, uses his feet and launches that over wide long-off
pushed to the off side
Dropped, tough chance at short cover, he was forward and slammed that hard and the ball deflected off his fingers cupped over his head
gets well forward and drives down to long-off
goes back and slams it hard to sweeper cover
blocks it towards point and they take a quick single
the googly this time and Samuels read it a but late, defended
flat delivery again, turn too this time, goes back and punches it to the off side
keeps very low and he makes room and slams it hard back to the bowler who deflects it to long-on
he's well forward and the ball hits his pads and rolls to the off side, confident appeal by the bowler
gets forward and steers it wide of cover for a couple
punches it down to long-off
just clears long-off! He gives the charge and lofts him flat and Hussey leaps at long-off and the ball hits his finger tips and goes over the rope
gets forward and steers it to the packed off side field at point
outside off and driven down to sweeper cover
full on the off stump and driven firmly down the ground and Harmeet misfielded at mid-off but Chawla did well to stop it before the rope
kept a touch low, shuffled across and clipped to fine leg
too wide down the leg side and too far for Uthappa to flick it away
goes right across his stumps and clips it to midwicket
the keeper is back close to the stumps, tight line outside off and pushed to the off side
attempts an inswinging yorker and it's a low full toss, gets an inside edge to this pads but the keeper reckoned it hit pad first
keeps it outside off and Samuels stabs it to the off side
similar shot, jams it back to the bowler for no run
on the legs, stays back and pushes it back to the bowler
angling in again, ball hits the toe end off the bat and rolls on the on side
on the full, defends it back to the bowler
knocks it to point off a ball which came into the batsmen
on the middle and leg, pushes to mid-on for a single
glanced off his legs
Gone! Run out, brilliant fielding from Praveen kumar, Samuels defends it to the off side and Ryder keeps charging but Praveen picks it up and effects a direct hit
on the pads, flicks it to short fine leg, easy single
guides it to backward point and Ryder was gone had that hit the stumps
caught at mid-off! slower delivery, does not pick it and hits it straight down the throat of mid-off fielder
goes a mile high into the air, Chawla runs back but cant get hold of it and falls on his back
shuffles across and scoops it high over to the fine leg for a two
back of a length, steers it to short third man and scamper home for a single, direct hit and he would have been gone
closes the face and nudges it to midwicket for an easy single
outside off, cuts it wide of the backward point fielder
back of a length, Ryder turns it to backward square, similar shot
makes room and looks to pull it over midwicket but the ball goes to the backward square
full, punched it off his front foot to wide of the diving Harmeet at long-on, good team effort there
good length, shows the full face of the bat and jams it back to the bowler
hit on his pads, Ganguly was well out of his crease, appeal from the bowler, but not out says the umpire
comes forward to a slower delivery and defends it solidly
wide outside off, knocks it softly to mid-off and sneak in a single
full on the pads, dabs it gently to Harmeet at short midwicket
outside off, steers it gently to the man at point for no run
half volley, puts his foot forward and pushes it to short midwicket
on the full, knocks it to mid-on for no single
good length, chops it, gets an inside edge and the ball runs away behind the keeper for a four
slower delivery, pushes it to midwicket and the batsmen hop over for a single
on the hips, err in line, gets punished, flicks it off his pads for a four
on the pads, knocks it to mid-on and Ryder tries to sneak a single but wisely sent back by Ganguly
outside off, drives it to point for no run
back of a length, Ganguly looks to nudge it to the off side, gets  an inside edge and off it races away to the fine leg fence
back of a length, pushes it to short midwicket for a single
on the leg stump, whips it off his legs to backward square leg and the game was well over before that final ball was bowled

full toss, biffs it through extra cover and the ball goes racing away to the sweeper cover fence, Bipul sharma is playing his part here, compensating for the mauling he had received off his own bowling
take that, Bipul sharma clubs it high over the bowler's head and it looks a very neat strike on replay
slams it down past the turf to long-on
on the money, digs it out to the off side
Dropped by Samuels himself, tries to go over midwicket but hits it mile high into the air   and Samuels gets under it and fluffs an easy chance, drops a sitter
Gone, caught at extra cover! makes room and tries to go over cover but does not get the elevation right and an easy catch to Ganguly
on the middle, Bipul sharma crunches this one to long-on for a one
straight and full, stays in the crease and slams it over the Umpire for a four, that's a clean strike with minimal foot movement
slower one on the stumps, Faulkner makes a room and tries to slap it down the ground but chops it on to his pads
slower one and sprayed it well outside the tram line, called a wide
flat outside off, punches it straight down the ground to long-off for a run
full on the off, slaps it straight to long-off for a single
on the pads, turns it away to deep midwicket where a misfield allows them to go through for a two
flat outside off, looks to go over midwicket but chops it onto his pads
on the legs, hits on the pads and falls on the pitch for no run
on the pads, nudges it off his hips to deep square leg for an easy two
clean strike this time! stays in the crease and mauls it high over the bowler's head for a Dorothy
slogged an outside off delivery over midwicket to wide of long-on for a four
flat and full, driven to long-off for a single
works it away to midwicket for a single
straight to long-on! Mascarenhas flat bats it from outside off straight down the throat of Ryder, he was looking to smack it over the man at long-on
on the pads, turns it away to long-on
yorker length, carves it straight to point
fired it on the stumps, punches it to deep midwicket for a single
looks to whip it to the leg side, thumps on the pads and it rolls in front of the pitch
flat outside off, mistimes the pull and slaps it to long-on for a single
outside off, steers it past the point
on the full again, nudges it away on to the leg side to wide of long-on
on the middle and leg, turned away to midwicket for an easy single
caught at long-on! quicker one outside off, Chawla flat bats it and tries to heave it over long-on but holes out to Pandey
on the off, comes forward and punches it down to long-off for an easy single
on the stumps, flat bats it back to the bowler for no run
off cutter, slower one, drives to cover for no run
full toss, french cuts it, takes the inside edge and races away to the fine leg boundary fence
picks it from off and smacks it over midwicket through the gap at deep midwicket for a four
on good length, stand and deliver, clubs it high over long-off for a massive six
Gone, Bowled! skids through again, a tad low, Hussey bends and looks to drive it through covers but the off stump is pegged back by the the time he brings his bat down
skids through, cuts it but straight to the man at point for no run, Rahul's keeping it tight here
on the off, knocks it to cover and try to sneak a single
goes deep into his crease and works it to deep square leg for a two
short, clobbered with brute power, picks it from outside off and send it straight  over midwicket for a six
on the pads, pushes it to midwicket for a single
outside off, on the money, cuts it straight to the man at point for a dot
Gone, caught at midwicket! slightly short, picks it from outside off and tries to go aerial over midwicket but Ganguly runs to his left and takes an easy catch
on his toes, drags it to the fielder at  midwicket and off they go for a quick single
on the legs, jumps in his crease, ball hits his pads and rolls on to the off side
on the middle, drives it to mid-off and sneak a quick single, mid-off has a shy at the stumps but misses, Nayar was gone had the stumps been broken
good length, stays in the crease and guides it to point, Smith at point dives and stops it really well
turned down to long-on and another easy single
jams out a full delivery to the off side, quick single
down the leg side and it deflects off the keeper, they take a run as well
good cricket, drops it with soft hands and he takes off for a quick single to cover
picking up the pace here! Opens the face of the bat late and steers it past a diving short third man
lovely shot! Ryder gives him too much width and he cuts it firmly to the big gap at deep point, good placement
nice tight line, he uses his wrists and flicks it wide of long-on
pulls a short one along the turf to wide long-on, good sliding stop
quicker through the air and worked to deep square leg
gets some turn this time, he clips it to midwicket
gets well forward and drives to the off side
gives him width and he chops it down to sweeper cover
turns it quietly down to short fine leg
drives a full delivery down to Smith at long-off
Hussey slices that in the air but wide of backward point, looked risky at first
outside edge! Mandeep makes a bit of room to carve that through the off side, doesn't pick the off cutter, thin edge and Uthappa knows it, easy one for the umpire
Nayar bashes it down the ground and calls "2" quickly, long-off doesn't let them
clipped back to the bowler, Ryder runs across quickly to stop it
Punjab will need more of those, this one keeps low and beats the edge and the keeper and races away
flatter and punched down to cover
fires it down the leg side and wide called
slashes and gets a bottom edge that trickles past the keeper and short fine leg chases and dives in vain
whips it down to wide long-on and he had to hurry that second run
it's a free hit and he can only hoick it down to deep mid-on
oversteps, high full toss and he was down the track and slapped to deep cover
that's a cracker! Makes room to a ball pitched a fraction short, pulled and really middled it and bisected the gap between two fielders at deep midwicket
on the pads and pushed down to long-on
on the legs, moves across and flicks it to backward square and go through for a single
straighter one, clipped to midwicket for a single
half volley, plays it gently to deep cover, look for two but they settle for a single
on good length, slog sweeps it to wide long-on but does not time it all
angling in, rocks back and turns it with soft hands to deep midwicket for two
on the full, punches it down the ground, deflects off Ryder's hand and goes to long-on
outside off, stays back and carves it to backward point for an easy single
comes forward and knocks it to short midwicket
makes room and gets hit on the pads and ball rolls on to the off side
bunts it on to the off side and sneak in a quick single
skids it through, blocks it back to the bowler
half volley, cuts it to sweeper cover and hop over for a single
another skidder, makes room and pushes it to mid-on for a single
makes room, slashes the delivery outside off to deep point fence for a four
skids it through the air, chops it on to the pitch
on the middle and off, pushes it back to the bowler
good length, knocked down to square leg for a single
on the pads, flicks it to short fine leg for nor run
outside off, Nayar stays in his crease and steers it to third man for a comfortable single
angling in, hits him on the back leg, Nehra goes for a huge appeal but the Umpire says 'no'
shaping away from the left hander, looks to drive it but misses and a nice carry to the keeper
angling in, comes slightly forward and pushes it back to mid-off
outside off, knocks it to mid-on for a quick single, tight one there
good length, hits the right pad and goes straight to the keeper who appeals for an lbw
on the legs, hits him on the pads, shaping away from the batsman, Uthappa appeals but in vain
chopped it to the off side for a quick single
angling in, steers it to short third man for no run
flat, knocks it to short cover for a quick single

Gone, Run out! Gilchrist this time, Mandeep closes the face and bunts it to short midwicket and Smith picks it and throws it to Uthappa who removes the bails off in a flash, Gilchrist is well short of his crease
flat, jabs it to the point fielder
on the full, flicks it to deep square leg for a single
fizzes past the outside edge again, Mandeep looks to cut it through point
good length, punches it to wide of mid-off for a single
zips past the outside edge of Gilchrist who looks to drive it but misses
outside off, chops it to the off side for no run
Run out! Valthaty is out, huge appeal for an LBW, hits him on the pads and rolls on to the off side, Smith picks it and throws it to the non strikers end, Valthaty sacrifices his wicket here
width on offer, slashes at it but cant get it past the point fielder who does well to stop it
goes forward and dabs it to point
on the off, punches it to cover
quicker one, tries to cut but misses
width offered, he punishes that with utter disdain to the point fence
half volley, comes off the inside edge and rolls to the on side
short on the hips, nudges it to short fine leg for a leg bye
outside off, steers it off the toe end off the bat to third man for a single
angling into the batsman, looks to pull and misses it, zips past very close to the off stump
short outside off, swings across the line and misses, no feet movement at all
short on the pads, plays it off his hips to short fine leg
back of a length, uses the pace and steers it to wide third man for a single
